name: MIAM!
description: A self-service restaurant with an immersive comic-book decor, serving a gourmet Caesar salad with breaded chicken, poke bowls and fresh fruit salad verrines. The menu formula is around €19.90. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Gourmet Caesar Salad
items.description: Caesar salad with breaded chicken and parmesan shavings

name: Bermuda Bar & Food
description: A Cuban-themed fast-food spot with airplane decor, serving the Cuban Bocadillo and the Cuban Burger with sweet potato fries, plus salads. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Cuban Bocadillo
items.description: Cuban sandwich with chips and dessert

items.name: Cuban Burger
items.description: Burger with sweet potato fries and dessert

name: L'Atelier des Saveurs
description: A table-service restaurant with traditional cuisine, known for a low-temperature rack of pork with morel jus. It offers a pasta or pizza plus dessert menu, and a Discovery Menu that must be booked ahead. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Rack of Pork
items.description: Low-temperature rack of pork with morel mushroom jus

name: Comptoirs du Monde
description: A street-food style fast-food spot serving hamburgers with fries, tacos and a kebab sandwich with a cone of fries. The menu formula is around €15.90. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Kebab Sandwich
items.description: Kebab sandwich with a cone of fries
